China News:
- Yellen says Washington might 'respond to unintended consequences' for China due to tech export curbs. [source](https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/yellen-washington-respond-unintended-consequences-china-due-tech-100997180)

Korea News:
- South Korea's Yoon pushes for strong resolve against North's nuclear ambitions at NATO summit. [source](https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/south-koreas-yoon-pushes-strong-resolve-norths-nuclear-100982116)

- China's defence chief warns West to stay away from its waters. [source](https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2023/06/04/taiwan-near-miss-china-defence-minister/)
- Blinken holds 'candid' talks with China's Xi amid effort to ease tensions. [source](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2023/06/19/blinken-china-xi-jinping-meeting/)"
}
